proposal.rationale: Starting with an aggressive opening offer of $35.00 to anchor the negotiation well below our target threshold, allowing sufficient margin to negotiate up while remaining strictly within our budget constraints.

The Ergonomic Mechanical Keyboard features premium hot-swappable custom switches, gasket mounting, and durable PBT keycaps. Given its list price of $75.00, $35.00 is too low, but I can offer a discount to $65.00.
Countering with $45.00 to show reasonable movement from our initial offer while keeping the negotiation firmly within our strict budget ceiling and below our human approval threshold.
